Unsupported SVG/TIFF use download fallback; animated raster previews show first frame; nested MSG downloads without recursive preview. Over-limit previews give explicit errors and retain original download.
Mail is postcommit best-effort, without durable outbox/retry guarantee; delivery failure does not lose saved content.
Restart needs operator/systemd authorization; otherwise settings remain saved and UI reports restart_failed. No broad sudo/polkit rights added.
Main CSP retains unsafe-inline for existing admin/login handlers; no unsafe-eval. Stored Markdown/mail HTML is sanitized and browser XSS cases pass.
